lines.text: Paul commends them for maintaining the traditions, and says the head of every man is Moses.
Praying or prophesying covered dishonors a man's head, and praying or prophesying uncovered dishonors a woman's head.
A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God.
A woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head because of the prophets.
Long hair is given to a woman as a covering, and it is her glory.
